name: review-walkthrough
description: Portable review-walkthrough skill conformance: behavior map, paced steps, natural controls, evidence anchors, and read-only boundaries

scenarios.name: map: pause before first behavior
scenarios.prompt:
Walk me through my staged changes in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts. I want to understand the change before I ask for any formal review.

Read `.claude/skills/review-walkthrough/SKILL.md` first. Build a change map before explaining the first behavior, then pause for my instruction. Review only; do not edit or commit.

judge: The agent binds the staged surface, gives a plain-language behavior map, and pauses before a detailed code explanation

scenarios.name: behavior: connect files in flow order
scenarios.prompt:
Walk me through the branch changes for the login session flow in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src. Explain the behavior across files in execution order, with key path and line anchors. Pause after the first behavior group.

Read `.claude/skills/review-walkthrough/SKILL.md` first. Review only; do not edit or commit.

judge: The agent explains the login behavior across auth, storage, and entry-point files instead of producing an unrelated file inventory

scenarios.name: controls: natural language pacing
scenarios.prompt:
Use the review walkthrough for the staged redirect change. Demonstrate how you handle natural controls: next, go deeper, why, show the code, back, skip, and stop. Keep progress in the conversation and do not create a review file.

Read `.claude/skills/review-walkthrough/SKILL.md` first. Review only; do not edit or commit.

judge: The agent defines natural-language controls that preserve the current step, move between groups, or end with a summary

scenarios.name: concern: call out without repairing
scenarios.prompt:
Walk me through the branch change in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/auth.ts. Explain the behavior and call out any concern you see, but do not repair it or turn this into a merge-readiness review.

Read `.claude/skills/review-walkthrough/SKILL.md` first. Review only; do not edit, commit, push, or submit a review.

judge: The agent labels a concern with its trigger and impact, keeps the walkthrough read-only, and points to code-review for formal review

scenarios.name: large change: group and pace
scenarios.prompt:
Walk me through this large branch change in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src. Group related changes by behavior, show the proposed order, and explain how I can skip or revisit a group. Do not force a line-by-line tour.

Read `.claude/skills/review-walkthrough/SKILL.md` first. Review only; do not edit or commit.

judge: The agent groups a multi-file change into behavior-sized sections and describes user-controlled pacing

scenarios.name: entry: unnamed source uses worktree only when non-empty
scenarios.prompt: Walk me through the changes in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts. I did not name a source, so use the current worktree only if it has changes. State which source you bind and pause after the map. Review only; do not edit or commit.

judge: The agent uses the worktree fallback only because the worktree has a change and states that binding explicitly

scenarios.name: entry: empty worktree asks for a source
scenarios.prompt: Walk me through the changes. The current worktree is empty. Do not guess from recent agent actions; tell me what you need from me.

judge: The agent stops at the entry gate and asks for a named source instead of inventing one

scenarios.name: entry: named commit and pull request sources
scenarios.prompt: Explain this named commit first, then tell me how the source binding differs for a pull request. Keep the two source identities separate and stay read-only.

judge: The agent binds a commit by full ID and describes a pull request with its current base and head identities without mixing them

scenarios.name: entry: named paths do not need a diff
scenarios.prompt: Walk me through the current files agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/auth.ts and agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/session-store.ts. There is no diff to use. Bind this as a path source and pause at the map.

judge: The agent explains that named current files form the source even without a diff

scenarios.name: snapshot: changed source rebuilds the map
scenarios.prompt: Walk me through this branch change one behavior at a time. After the first pause, assume the branch head changes before I say next. Explain the stale-source response and keep old and new versions separate.

judge: The agent binds branch identity, rechecks it before advancing, and restarts from a new map when the head changes

scenarios.name: controls: first and last group boundaries
scenarios.prompt: Use the walkthrough controls on the staged redirect change. Test back at the map, skip and revisit a group, and skip the last group. Keep the result as an understanding summary.

judge: The agent handles map and last-group boundaries, and a revisited skipped group is no longer treated as skipped

scenarios.name: concern: confirmed requires trigger and impact evidence
scenarios.prompt: Explain this branch change and label a concern as confirmed only if the code and a failing test or reproduction show both its trigger and impact. Keep the walkthrough read-only and do not make a merge decision.

judge: The agent uses confirmed only after stating code and test or reproduction evidence for both the trigger and impact
